006package dev.metaschema.core.datatype.markup;
007
008import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonParser;
009
010import org.codehaus.stax2.XMLEventReader2;
011
012import java.io.IOException;
013import java.net.URI;
014import java.util.List;
015
016import javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamException;
017
018import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
019import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IMarkupLineItem;
020import dev.metaschema.core.qname.EQNameFactory;
021import dev.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
022import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
023import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
024
025/**
026 * Support for the Metaschema <a href=
027 * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#markup-line">markup-line</a>
028 * data type.
029 */
030public class MarkupLineAdapter
031    extends AbstractMarkupAdapter<MarkupLine, IMarkupLineItem> {
032  @NonNull
033  private static final List<IEnhancedQName> NAMES = ObjectUtils.notNull(
034      List.of(
035          EQNameFactory.instance().newQName(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH, "markup-line")));
036
037  MarkupLineAdapter() {
038    super(MarkupLine.class, IMarkupLineItem.class, IMarkupLineItem::cast);
039  }
040
041  @Override
042  public List<IEnhancedQName> getNames() {
043    return NAMES;
044  }
045
046  /**
047   * Parse a line of Markdown.
048   */
049  @Override
050  public MarkupLine parse(String value) {
051    return MarkupLine.fromMarkdown(value);
052  }
053
054  @SuppressWarnings("null")
055  @Override
056  public MarkupLine parse(XMLEventReader2 eventReader, URI resource) throws IOException {
057    try {
058      return XmlMarkupParser.instance().parseMarkupline(eventReader, resource);
059    } catch (XMLStreamException ex) {
060      throw new IOException(ex);
061    }
062  }
063
064  @Override
065  public MarkupLine parse(JsonParser parser, URI resource) throws IOException {
066    @SuppressWarnings("null")
067    MarkupLine retval = parse(parser.getValueAsString());
068    // skip past value
069    parser.nextToken();
070    return retval;
071  }
072
073  @Override
074  public String getDefaultJsonValueKey() {
075    return "RICHTEXT";
076  }
077
078  @Override
079  public IMarkupLineItem newItem(Object value) {
080    MarkupLine item = toValue(value);
081    return IMarkupLineItem.valueOf(item);
082  }
083}
